trucking_exception_open_idx.name: trucking_exception_open_idx
trucking_exception_open_idx.where: closed_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

trucking_consignment_quote_unique.name: trucking_consignment_quote_unique
trucking_consignment_quote_unique.where: quote_number IS NOT NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL AND sell->>'source' = 'QUOTE'

trucking_consignment_stamp_order_check.name: trucking_consignment_stamp_order_check
trucking_consignment_stamp_order_check.value: ("trucking_consignment"."delivered_at" IS NULL OR "trucking_consignment"."picked_up_at" IS NOT NULL OR "trucking_consignment"."gate_in_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("trucking_consignment"."pod_received_at" IS NULL OR "trucking_consignment"."delivered_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("trucking_consignment"."ready_to_bill_at" IS NULL OR "trucking_consignment"."pod_received_at" IS NOT NULL)

trucking_tariff_owner_unique.name: trucking_tariff_owner_unique
trucking_tariff_owner_unique.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND owner_customer_id IS NOT NULL

trucking_tariff_no_owner_unique.name: trucking_tariff_no_owner_unique
trucking_tariff_no_owner_unique.where: deleted_at IS NULL AND owner_customer_id IS NULL

trucking_tariff_owner_check.name: trucking_tariff_owner_check
trucking_tariff_owner_check.value: ("trucking_tariff"."side" = 'BUY' AND "trucking_tariff"."owner_customer_id" IS NOT NULL) OR "trucking_tariff"."side" = 'SELL' OR ("trucking_tariff"."side" = 'INTERNAL' AND "trucking_tariff"."owner_customer_id" IS NULL)

trucking_tariff_mode_check.name: trucking_tariff_mode_check
trucking_tariff_mode_check.value: ("trucking_tariff"."mode" = 'MATRIX' AND "trucking_tariff"."discount_percent" IS NULL) OR ("trucking_tariff"."mode" = 'DISCOUNT' AND "trucking_tariff"."side" = 'SELL' AND "trucking_tariff"."owner_customer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "trucking_tariff"."discount_percent" IS NOT NULL AND "trucking_tariff"."discount_percent" > -100 AND "trucking_tariff"."discount_percent" < 100)

trucking_tariff_version_superseded_check.name: trucking_tariff_version_superseded_check
trucking_tariff_version_superseded_check.value: "trucking_tariff_version"."superseded_at" IS NULL OR "trucking_tariff_version"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL
